Asset type: landscape production mechanism sheet, 3:2, six panels, two rows of three. Main title "BACKSTAGE MACHINES". Subtitle "07-12 / MOVEMENT AND TIMING". One substantial colored mechanism plus one small before/after action inset per panel. Do not repeat existing six devices. In strict reading order:
07 "SCENERY RAILS": two theatrical painted scenery flats, a narrow balcony and a cutout door, move horizontally on floor rails via brass rack gear. Target on switching clutch. Inset shows one flat sliding away to open low route while carrying Lira on top toward an upper ledge; a cyan catch platform.
08 "TRAPDOOR ROW": a row of four hinged stage hatches with linked brass trip levers under floor. A wind-up gremlin stepping on first lever creates sequential opening, clearly shown wave of hinge arrows. Lira leaps over opening hatches while guardian has drawn a cyan receiving platform underneath. Different from just one collapsing tile.
09 "STUNT CANNON": ornate coral barrel and teal brass carriage with angle-lock target. TWO selectable firing angles, horizontal low lane and upward high arc; one tiny canonical human Lira visible flying up, a packed gremlin crowd along low arc. Show spring launch cylinder, not ammunition or gun violence.
10 "PROP CONVEYOR": reversible brass-and-teal stage conveyor carries wooden crates and gremlins toward a trapdoor or a counterweight pan depending on direction. Amber target at gear, arrows visibly opposite in small inset, Lira runs against moving deck.
11 "CONFETTI VENT": stage floor air nozzle emits a narrow upward column of colored paper streamers, direction duct and pressure dial clearly visible. Cannon-like air pushes airborne gremlins and Lira upward; a cyan drawn wall diverts an alternate gust toward a side balcony. Keep the dangerous path readable through sparse confetti, not opaque fog.
12 "PENDULUM BELL": heavy brass theatre announcement bell swings on hanging yoke and can physically knock approaching gremlins into lower lane. Shoot amber striker latch to change phase of swing, curved path arrows with small gremlins on one side and Lira taking the alternate raised path.
Readable numbered plaques 07-12 with exact device names only, optional small ink cutaway by each. Devices and their consequences are central, tiny humans faithfully match supplied sprite, enemy masks remain separate. No repeated gate, accordion, wheel or spotlight.

Asset type: landscape production mechanism sheet, 3:2, six panels, two rows of three. Title "ILLUSIONS AND CHAIN REACTIONS". Subtitle "13-18 / CHANGE THE ENSEMBLE". One large colored machine and one action inset per panel. Strict order:
13 "MIRROR SPOT": brass framed stage mirror reflects a theatre lamp beam onto a movable screen. Screen shows ONLY a flat silhouette/SHADOW of Lira as a decoy (clearly no physical clone). Wind-up gremlins turn toward it while the one real human Lira takes another passage. Amber pivot on mirror, two beam positions.
14 "PAPER MOON": huge suspended crescent moon stage prop made of painted wood over visible braces. Shoot rope latch to lower the moon into a cloud gap as a curved bridge. Lira walks on upper curve, gremlins below. Inset shows high decorative hanging pose then low bridge pose. No second real moon in sky.
15 "BALANCING BALCONY": ornate double-ended theatre balcony on central fulcrum, gremlins pile on one end and raise the other end carrying Lira; locks at two angles, cyan catch platform shows safe recovery. Show different weight distribution, not Ferris wheel.
16 "MAGNETIC PROP HOIST": overhead teal electromagnet on mobile rig picks up metallic puppet enemies but leaves the human Lira unaffected on the floor. Shoot amber polarity switch releases a group into a counterweight pan. Clear coil, suspended three gremlins and release path, no magnet attached to hero.
17 "FIREWORK RACK": small festival stage pyrotechnic rack with three visible fuse stages and predictable warning bulbs. Shooting ignition target starts a staggered sequence of bright theatrical star bursts that redirect a gremlin crowd; Lira takes raised cyan escape bridge before the next burst. Show timer order 1→2→3 with pictorial fuse marks, no gore, no actual text paragraphs.
18 "BREAKAWAY SCENERY": false painted opera wall with a fragile seam. A mechanical masked hound charging toward real Lira breaks through it to reveal a previously hidden staircase behind. Tiny inset illustrates intact false wall and open staircase, Lira has escaped onto cyan platform while hound reaches seam. This device activates by luring enemy impact, not another shoot-to-open gate.
English exact names and 13-18 only besides titles. Theatre materials and clear moving parts. No costumes/disguises or changes to Lira's original identity; no generic traps outside this world.

Asset type: landscape anime enemy model sheet, 3:2. Input existing enemy modelsheet is the established style/family reference, NOT an edit target. Four equally spaced columns, one large full-body painted model, one small side/rear view, and one clear behavior vignette in each. Title "BACKSTAGE TROUBLEMAKERS". 06 "PROP MIMIC": squat teal wooden prop trunk with coral theatre mask embossed on hinged lid, brass clasp, little articulated feet and gold slit eyes hidden until opening. Closed ordinary trunk view vs open puppet-monster view. Vignette shows crowd pushing closed crate onto conveyor and lid opening to block an exit.
07 "RIGGING SPIDER": distinct nonhuman eight-legged brass pulley creature, central thread spool, teal shell with tiny red comedy mask, cable-tipped limbs. 08 "CANNON IMP": low round puppet on two carriage wheels, coral grin mask, teal body, integrated short theatrical spring cannon barrel as an arm and visible wind-up charge gauge. Vignette shows a clearly telegraphed low shot knocks gremlins toward conveyor; charge, release states.
09 "RIBBON ACROBAT": slender segmented teal puppet in coral diamond-pattern bodysuit and mask, long TWO red aerial silk ribbons attached to roof. Swings between balcony lanes, small joint rings and knot latch. Vignette shows shot knot releases one ribbon, swinging direction reverses and puppet lands in lower lane.
Preserve coral/teal/brass family while varying silhouette strongly: box, spider, wheels, long hanging figure. Clear technical side views and behavior, no generic humanoid recolors, all bodies/ribbons fully within panel. Exact titles, names and numbers only.

Use the six-zone composition described below. This is a NEW denser expansion, not an exact game screenshot. Preserve six clearly separated numbered chapters left to right with two connected route heights. Three machine identifiers per zone: one core prop at center, two supporting devices beside it. Devices remain readable; numbered tiny round badges A01-A18 replace crowded prose labels. Red arrows for enemy flow, cyan arrows for HUMAN Lira's route, amber rings for shootable mechanisms. Include a modest landscape backdrop; scenery never overwhelms route. The original runner sprite reference has priority over every generated illustration.
01 "FALSE ENTRANCE": A01 smiling MASK GATE jaw bridge central; A07 two horizontally sliding SCENERY RAILS flats; A08 linked TRAPDOOR ROW. Existing gremlins and trunk mimic. Human Lira clearly on cyan path after gate, brown hair/red scarf/blue outfit.
02 "BACKSTAGE": A02 CURTAIN LIFT paired counterweight; A12 swinging PENDULUM BELL; A16 MAGNETIC PROP HOIST picking metal gremlins above lower lane. Stilt usher on high route and rigging spider among ropes.
03 "PARADE CROSSING": A03 circular PARADE TURNTABLE; A09 selectable-angle STUNT CANNON; A10 reversible PROP CONVEYOR feeding exits. Drum major, cannon imp and dense gremlin groups. HUMAN Lira on high escape lane, not a masked gremlin.
04 "ACCORDION GAP": A04 bellows ACCORDION BRIDGE over cloud gap; A11 sparse CONFETTI VENT on boarding side; A15 BALANCING BALCONY at far side. Balloon harlequin carrying weight, ribbon acrobat above. Clear launch arc from Lira on bridge to cyan catch platform, then upper balcony.
05 "SPOTLIGHT GALLERY": A05 FOLLOW SPOT revealing marionette; A13 MIRROR SPOT projecting a clearly FLAT hero shadow on screen; A18 BREAKAWAY SCENERY wall revealing stairs after charging clockwork hound breaks it. Mirror twins on lower lane. One real HUMAN Lira on a cyan escape platform; shadow decoy should be flat monochrome.
06 "SKY WHEEL FINALE": A06 sun-faced SKY WHEEL with horizontal hanging cabins; A14 lowered crescent PAPER MOON makes boarding bridge; A17 three fuse FIREWORK RACK on safe-facing balcony. Stage manager miniboss on separated rear control perch, cue cords visible, gremlins loading opposite cabin. Human Lira boards upper cabin and transfers to real red GOAL flag.
